tools.name: Create Sheets
tools.description: Create sheets from an Excel register, including title block, drawing category and series parameters.

tools.name: Assign Views on Sheets
tools.description: Place views on selected sheets with typed offsets or picked calibration points.

tools.name: Export Drawings
tools.description: Export sheets, print sets or revisions to PDF, DWG or DWF with custom file naming.

tools.name: Export & Import Schedules
tools.description: Round-trip schedule data through Excel, matching rows by element GUID.

tools.name: Annotation Fixer
tools.description: Check selected sheets for annotations outside the title block and align issues to a reference.

tools.name: Element History
tools.description: Log added and modified elements, or inspect the recorded history of selected elements.

tools.name: Apply Coping
tools.description: Find intersecting bracing members and apply coping, with optional columns as cutting members.

tools.name: Join Geometry
tools.description: Join elements between two chosen categories in the active view, with optional cut priority.

tools.name: Concrete Beam Number
tools.description: Number in-situ concrete beams in plan order—horizontal first, then vertical—and write to Mark.

tools.name: Steel Beam Number
tools.description: Number hot-rolled steel beams in the same plan order and add an SB prefix to Mark.

tools.name: Beam Coordinates
tools.description: Write beam start, end and centre X/Y values in survey-point coordinates.

tools.name: Column Number
tools.description: Group columns into vertical runs and assign one mark per run, with C, TC or FC prefixes.

tools.name: Column Split
tools.description: Split columns at chosen levels while keeping the original mark and zero base/top offsets.

tools.name: Pile Coordinates
tools.description: Write pile coordinates transformed from Revit internal coordinates to survey-point coordinates.

tools.name: Pile Number
tools.description: Number piles by prefix, start number, family filter and chosen numbering direction.

tools.name: Pile Spacing
tools.description: Check round-pipe piles against a minimum centre spacing based on a factor of pile diameter.

tools.name: Wall Number
tools.description: Number selected walls by plan position and write the result to Mark, with W, TW, RW or WT prefixes.

tools.name: Wall Split
tools.description: Split walls at chosen levels while keeping the original mark and zero base/top offsets.
